paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: wisdom is not hiding. She takes her stand at the crossroads and the city gates, and she is NOT whispering (Proverbs 8:2-3). She calls to everybody, even the simple ones and the fools, and tells them to learn and gain understanding (Proverbs 8:4-5). If you've ever thought wisdom was a club you had to be smart enough to join, this passage says the door is wide open.

And she's worth it. She says, 'Receive my instruction instead of silver, and knowledge rather than pure gold' (Proverbs 8:10). She says she was there when God established the heavens, and that she was 'a skilled craftsman at His side, and His delight day by day' (Proverbs 8:27, 30). So when you listen to wisdom, you're not picking up some dusty life hack. You're listening to a voice that was there before the mountains were settled (Proverbs 8:25).

Then she brings it home: 'whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD' (Proverbs 8:35). She also says that 'he who fails to find me harms himself' (Proverbs 8:36). So the choice is plain, and she laid it out loud and clear. Show up daily, keep your ears open, and wait at her doorway like I wait at the oven window, nose pressed to the glass (Proverbs 8:34).
